It is not evidence of construction start, construction completion, opening, legal occupancy, actual occupancy, design quality, safety condition, affordability, neighborhood outcome, or causal effect. Linked job-application scale fields are source-reported proposed/application attributes and may be amended; legacy DOB rows can contain data-entry anomalies, so extreme scale values were screened and raw fields are retained for review.
candidates.transformation_method: scripts/fetch_round588_nyc_dob_legacy_permit_next23_candidates.js queried official NYC Open Data DOB Job Application Filings high-signal rows, joined them by legacy job number to official DOB Permit Issuance rows, retained initial issued NB/AL permits within 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-20, and screened against the manual corpus plus prior NYC DOB legacy permit, DOB NOW, DOB CO, and screened permit candidate packs through Round583 by permit SI number, job number, source/date key, source URL, title/date key, and address/date key.
candidates.area: 511 WEST 25TH STREET, Manhattan, New York City
